description: This file contains utility functions and classes for handling lookup dialogs, popups, AJAX requests, and UI interactions within a web application, specifically related to field lookups and dynamic content loading.

classes.name: Lookup
classes.description: Class managing the AJAX-based lookup dialog, including initialization, container modification, dialog options, and event handling.

classes.name: FieldLookupCounter
classes.description: Counter object for managing unique lookup identifiers and references.

classes.name: ButtonModifier
classes.description: Class for modifying lookup UI elements, such as collapsing panels, buttons, pagination, and result tables.

classes.name: lookupDescriptionLoaded
classes.description: Helper class for loading and updating lookup field descriptions via AJAX.

methods.name: getViewNameWithSeparator
methods.description: Constructs a view URL with the appropriate separator ('?' or '&') based on existing query parameters.

methods.name: lookup_error
methods.description: Displays an error alert with a specified message.

methods.name: lookup_popup1
methods.description: Opens a popup window for lookup selection with specified view and size.

methods.name: lookup_popup2
methods.description: Opens a secondary lookup popup with additional arguments.

methods.name: fieldLookup1
methods.description: Constructor for a field lookup object handling validation and popup invocation.

methods.name: fieldLookup2
methods.description: Constructor for a field lookup object supporting two target controls.

methods.name: call_fieldlookup3
methods.description: Creates a fieldLookup2 instance and triggers its popup2 method.

methods.name: call_fieldlookup
methods.description: Creates a fieldLookup1 instance and triggers its popup method with default sizes if not provided.

methods.name: call_fieldlookup2
methods.description: Creates a fieldLookup1 instance and triggers its popup2 method.

methods.name: CollapsePanel
methods.description: Collapses or expands a UI panel.

methods.name: initiallyCollapse
methods.description: Automatically collapses panels if configured to do so.

methods.name: initiallyCollapseDelayed
methods.description: Delays the initial collapse action.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Main class managing lookup dialog lifecycle, AJAX content loading, and event handling.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the lookup dialog, container, and event handlers.

methods.name: _modifyContainer
methods.description: Modifies the input container, replacing input with a button and hidden div.

methods.name: _createAjaxAutoComplete
methods.description: Sets up AJAX auto-completion if ajaxUrl is provided.

methods.name: _createDialogOptions
methods.description: Creates dialog configuration options based on parameters.

methods.name: _positioning
methods.description: Determines dialog positioning based on configuration.

methods.name: _dialogOpen
methods.description: Handles opening of the lookup dialog, AJAX content loading, and UI setup.

methods.name: _lookupChaining
methods.description: Sets up chaining between multiple lookup dialogs.

methods.name: _activateLookup
methods.description: Sets the currently active lookup.

methods.name: _addCloseEventForClickingOnBackgroundLayer
methods.description: Adds event to close dialog when clicking outside.

methods.name: _dialogClose
methods.description: Handles closing of the dialog and restoring previous lookup.

methods.name: _addOpenEvent
methods.description: Binds click event to open the lookup dialog.

methods.name: FieldLookupCounter.setReference
methods.description: Stores a reference to a lookup object with a unique key.

methods.name: FieldLookupCounter.getReference
methods.description: Retrieves a stored lookup object by key.

methods.name: FieldLookupCounter.getLastReference
methods.description: Returns the key for the last created lookup.

methods.name: FieldLookupCounter.createNextKey
methods.description: Generates a new unique key for a lookup.

methods.name: FieldLookupCounter.countFields
methods.description: Counts the number of stored lookup references.

methods.name: FieldLookupCounter.removeReference
methods.description: Removes a lookup reference by key.

methods.name: ButtonModifier.modifyLookupLinks
methods.description: Modifies UI elements within a lookup, such as collapse toggles, submit buttons, pagination, and result tables.

methods.name: _modifyCollapseable
methods.description: Adds toggle functionality to collapsible panels.

methods.name: _getNextCollapseSeq
methods.description: Increments and returns the next collapse sequence number.

methods.name: _modifySubmitButton
methods.description: Replaces the submit button with a custom button that triggers AJAX.

methods.name: _modifyPagination
methods.description: Enhances pagination controls to trigger AJAX requests.

methods.name: _modifyResultTable
methods.description: Modifies links in the result table for AJAX-based navigation.

methods.name: lookupAjaxRequest
methods.description: Performs AJAX load for lookup content.

methods.name: lookupFormAjaxRequest
methods.description: Submits lookup form via AJAX and updates content.

methods.name: lookupPaginationAjaxRequest
methods.description: Handles AJAX pagination requests.

methods.name: setSourceColor
methods.description: Highlights a source element.

methods.name: set_duration_value
methods.description: Sets a value in the calling window for duration fields.

methods.name: set_value
methods.description: Sets a value in the calling window.

methods.name: set_values
methods.description: Sets multiple values in the calling window.

methods.name: write_value
methods.description: Writes a value into a target input element.

methods.name: set_multivalues
methods.description: Sets multiple values into target inputs, with optional multiple arguments.

methods.name: closeLookup
methods.description: Closes the lookup window or dialog.

methods.name: lookupDescriptionLoaded
methods.description: Class for loading and updating lookup field descriptions via AJAX.
